title: Question 20
passage:
Which drawer has the spare keys for the bike rack?
A. The shallow one right under the counter. B. I locked my bike there before breakfast. C. The rack can hold six bikes at a time.
passageZh:
自行車架的備用鑰匙放在哪一個抽屜？
A. 櫃檯正下方那個淺抽屜。
B. 我早餐前把自行車鎖在那裡。
C. 車架一次可以停六輛自行車。
